claim: date::weekday::weekday_from_days(z) returns the day of week in [0,6] with 0 = Sunday, written as the two-branch expression z >= -4 ? (u+4) % 7 : u % 7 over u = (unsigned)z because C++ division truncates toward zero, so the negative branch is required for the mathematical modulo to come out right; date::weekday::iso_encoding() is the same value with 0 mapped to 7, giving the ISO 8601 Monday=1..Sunday=7 numbering.
